title: Qualify immutable published Standard Expression Quantities binaries on Ubuntu WSL Linux net11
commitMessage: test: qualify published Math Standard binaries on Linux net11

contribution.summary: Execute the original ten-check Standard NuGet binary fixture on Linux x64 under net11 using the three immutable published package archives.
contribution.value: Validate all three original archives and DLL SHA-256 identities, stage exact-byte copies into an isolated WSL-accessible feed, restore the original Standard PackageReference under SDK 11.0.100, execute the ten-contract fixture and recheck original and snapshot hashes. No publication or production mutation.
debtChanges: RS248 succeeded first-pass attempt 001 and qualified the three-package Standard dependency chain under Windows SDK11.
RS249 extends the same immutable published package closure and ten-check fixture to Linux WSL x64 SDK11 without claiming whole-Math compatibility or M8 readiness.
contribution.nextAction: Assess remaining package graph and platform migration gates; keep M8 not-ready pending actual coverage and rollback qualification.
